S040-01.notes: 'first thing visitors notice' = salient (prominent). Concealed/modest contradict; temporary unsupported. Each choice inserted; only D fits.

S040-02.notes: Almost all local films = parochial (narrowly local). Eclectic is the opposite; ambitious/controversial not supported by the colon's elaboration.

S040-03.notes: Introduces Pando, then 'however' grazing prevents trunk replacement. Other choices describe content not present.

S040-04.notes: Deprived bees did dance (rules out A), stayed less accurate on distance despite practice (rules out D), and distance being impaired by lack of observation contradicts B. C is the cautious, supported inference.

S040-05.notes: Conclusion contrasts frozen (-18C, 95%) with room temperature (20C, 30%); only B cites both. A and C omit one endpoint; D irrelevant.

S040-06.notes: A mid-October charcoal date (fades within months) from 79 CE implies Pompeii was not yet buried in August. Consistent with the real 2018 Regio V inscription find. A irrelevant to season; B is from 78; C supports the traditional date.

S040-07.notes: Text 2 dates markings to before modern humans arrived, implying Neanderthal authorship, which challenges Text 1's claim. Conditional 'if their dates are accurate' mirrors 'If the dates hold up'. Slight leap from 'red markings' to 'symbolic images' but intended and acceptable.

S040-08.notes: Only C pairs limited training ('largely self-taught') with major recognition (Royal Society Fellow) via a concessive.

S040-09.notes: Benefits then a drawback (higher cost): contrast/concession 'At the same time'. Others imply cause, example, or summary.

S040-10.notes: 'little ___' needs a singular noun: effect. 'little effects' is ungrammatical with 'little' as a quantifier of mass noun; affect/affected are verb forms.
